title: FIELD SKETCH - blind-d-workshop (synthetic plan for the blind-transcription trial)
interpretations: L-shaped room transcribed clockwise from the NW corner: E 8'-6", S 2'-1", E 7'-5", S 7'-5", W 15'-11", N 9'-6". All six values are written on the plan; no chain arithmetic is drawn, so no parts are recorded.

Closure cross-check (transcription only, no blending): 8'-6" + 7'-5" = 15'-11" matches the stated south wall, and 2'-1" + 7'-5" = 9'-6" matches the stated west wall. The polygon closes exactly as stated.

The gap in the south wall with the 'DR 36"' callout is read as a 36"-wide door opening in the south wall (run index 4). The single vertical stroke at the east jamb is read as the door leaf swinging into the room, hinged on the east jamb — the jamb nearer the SE corner, i.e. hinge 'near' for a W-direction run.

The door's position along the south wall is NOT dimensioned anywhere on the plan. It is recorded as assumed, with the value scaled from photo pixel geometry (the east jamb sits roughly 100" west of the SE corner; the pixel width of the gap independently scales to ~36", consistent with the DR 36" callout, which supports the scaling but was not used to alter any stated number).
No door height is written on the plan; 'h' is omitted so the pipeline builds 80" flagged DEFAULT.
Wall thickness and sill are not stated; both fields are omitted so the 4" / 48" house defaults apply.

The '7'-5"' value appears twice on the plan — once on the lower top wall segment (horizontal) and once on the right wall (vertical). They are two different walls that happen to share a dimension; both were transcribed independently from their own callouts.
